reported_symptoms: After V1500B replacement, the router did not show an IP through either onboard Ethernet or the expansion10GbE card.
The first three drive bays reportedly failed to spin their disks.
interpretation: The firmware ReadyToBoot callback could not find JMB585 at its expected bridge.
time_correlation: A subsequent successful boot collected the stale messages while its clock was reset; nearby records correlate that collection with2025-08-19 evening.
limits: The messages do not name the CPU that produced them.
Four messages do not establish four separate boots.
ReadyToBoot is a reached stage, not proof of the final stopping stage.
No failed V1500B serial or PCI enumeration trace is available.
